mapping_rule: All required_tasks_all are required for a packet; a name match, subfixture, stale receipt or PASS on one member cannot close the source packet.
source_namespace_rule: SPEC_A gates G0..G10, SPEC_B G00..G20, SPEC_C G00..G14 and unified release gates are separate namespaces; read the source criterion, not the bare number.
scope_limit: Work-package coverage audit, not proof that every source paragraph is semantically accepted or that any capability is implemented. Original six unique October-17 self-play specs and 66-task ledger remain preserved.

**WP00 — Freeze baseline and evidence.**  
Owner competency: maintainer/evaluation. Depends: none.  
Area: records, release fixtures and current profile manifests.

Capture source revision, historical program/grammar/numerical identities, current exported target matrix, representative program/fitted-state fixtures and exact candidate-sequence controls. Register the existing and successor routes separately.

**Done when:** the static counts and source paths in section 6 reproduce; old-route conformance fixtures are runnable; every known limitation is represented as supported, unsupported, prototype or receipt-gated rather than guessed. Gates: G00/G01.

**WP01 — Descriptor and capability authority.**  
Owner competency: runtime/compiler. Depends: WP00.  
Area: existing registry and generated records.

Add successor type/effect/domain/resource/state/export/action fields. Generate a route-specific capability matrix. Retain inherited lifecycle checks and old registry authority.

**Done when:** positive-weight or advertised successor actions without runtime/export witnesses are rejected; frozen registry/grammar checks remain unchanged; unsupported states have precise reasons. Gate: G00.

**WP02 — Parameter and numeric repair witnesses.**  
Owner competency: numerical/runtime. Depends: WP00/WP01.  
Area: affected legacy implementations and successor descriptors.

Create reproduction fixtures for permissive ratio domains, missing-zero collision, width visibility, absolute output clamps and ignored parameters. Implement only one narrowly scoped successor repair per change.

**Done when:** each changed parameter has a declared effect witness; valid zeros remain distinct from missing values in the new path; repaired programs have new identities; old fixtures remain unchanged. Gates: G01/G06.

**WP03 — Strict successor reader and canonical identity.**  
Owner competency: compiler. Depends: WP01.  
Area: kernel/ir/learning frontend/codec.

Bound bytes/nesting during reading; reject duplicates, invalid numeric kinds, unknown versions and unresolved references; preserve exact literals and parameter ties; alpha-normalize locals.

**Done when:** canonical roundtrip, malformed-input and pre-allocation limits pass; no duplicate field is silently overwritten. Gates: G02/G03.

**WP04 — Exact-or-opaque legacy bridge.**  
Owner competency: compiler/runtime. Depends: WP03.  
Area: existing legacy bridge plus successor wrapper.

Store original bytes/identity and relation proof. Keep unsupported exact conversions opaque; bind execution/export to the old qualified path.

**Done when:** all W01 fixtures retain their promised behavior and targets; conversion failure does not remove capability; old/source/successor identities cannot collide. Gate: G01.

**WP05 — Schema/value pointers and numeric action ABI.**  
Owner competency: search/policy. Depends: WP01/WP03.  
Area: jope-policy draft edit ABI, checked action adapter, schema resolver.

Bind raw/derived references and exact numeric values to checked nodes rather than tokens. Record proposed versus executed/refined identities. Preserve old lossy projection as a separately identified channel.

**Done when:** columns 17/63/511 where admitted, schema reorder, missing key, stale derived reference and off-bin values survive or refuse correctly through action → fit → Rust fitted export. Gates: G03/G08/G10.

**WP06 — Lazy control and pure DAG execution.**  
Owner competency: compiler/runtime. Depends: WP03/WP04.  
Area: learning regions, interpreter and first Rust fitted lowering.

Implement Let, branch/join, explicit concatenation, exact width and typed lazy conditional. Keep automatic algebraic optimization disabled initially.

**Done when:** W03/W04 execute natively and as emitted fitted artifacts; inactive invalid branches are not evaluated; cycles, dangling values and illegal widths refuse before fit. Gates: G03/G05/G08.

**WP07 — Nested fitting and cache signatures.**  
Owner competency: effects/evaluation. Depends: WP06.  
Area: FitPlan successor adapter, pipeline planner, state cache.

Add NestedFitScope without changing narrow. Implement complete fit signatures and runtime-projected data views. Track selection/tuning ancestry.

**Done when:** nested row exclusions, cross-fold cache rejection, supervised-selection canaries, group/time constraints and numeric-payload noninterference pass. Gate: G04.

**WP08 — Fitted composition and exports.**  
Owner competency: runtime/evaluation. Depends: WP07.  
Area: existing draft combinators reconciled through the common executor.

Implement two-base stacking, OOF residual stacking and a separately specified gate/branch fitting policy. Preserve ordinary boosting semantics.

**Done when:** W05 fits, refits, freezes, reloads and exports; selection/preprocessing occurs in the right closures; empty partitions/fold failures have defined outcomes. Gates: G04/G08.

**WP09 — Variable projection.**  
Owner competency: numerical ML. Depends: WP02/WP06/WP07.  
Area: existing refinement and feature/ridge fitting seams.

Implement bounded multi-feature fitting and shared nonlinear constants with explicit scale/rank/derivative policy. Reuse current refinement only where qualified.

**Done when:** W06/W07 independent solves, derivatives, state and exports pass; pilot reports complete time/cost versus current refinement. Gates: G06/G07/G08/G13 for benefit claims.

**WP10 — Kernel/operator algebra.**  
Owner competency: numerical ML. Depends: WP06/WP07 and the required solve subset.  
Area: existing GPR/kernel code and successor typed descriptors.

Add valid PSD constructors, schema subsets, pullbacks/gates and explicit approximation/operator storage. Start with small dense and low-rank cases.

**Done when:** W14 construction, solve, approximation identity and artifact tests pass; arbitrary similarities cannot acquire a PSD certificate. Gates: G06/G08.

**WP11 — Bounded tensor/state learner runtime.**  
Owner competency: compiler/runtime. Depends: WP03/WP06/WP07.  
Area: learning IR, reference executor, state codec.

Implement records, parameter references, state transitions, tensor operations, bounded scan and finalization. Begin with a manually differentiated or analytic-gradient tiny learner before general reverse AD.

**Done when:** a complete learner fits/finalizes/reloads/predicts; state/loop/allocation bounds hold; interrupted work cannot publish a complete model. Gates: G03/G05/G11.

**WP12 — First-order AD and solver derivatives.**  
Owner competency: numerical/compiler. Depends: WP11.  
Area: pure-region AD and qualified numerical primitives.

Implement JVP/VJP, tied parameters, bounded-scan differentiation, tape planning and the initial solve derivative subset. Keep unavailable derivatives explicit.

**Done when:** W09–W11, analytic/directional/adjoint tests, nonsmooth policy and failure boundaries pass. Gate: G07.

**WP13A — Checked DAG genetic edits.**  
Owner competency: search. Depends: WP05/WP06.  
Area: existing graph edit/search interfaces.

Implement deterministic CheckedEdit, generation masks, capture-safe crossover and replay for the composition subset.

**Done when:** tiny-space enumeration, both-parent traces, later-column edits and native/export descendants pass; unchanged/rejected outcomes are counted. Gate: G09.

**WP13B — State/update genetic edits.**  
Owner competency: search/compiler. Depends: WP11/WP12/WP13A.

Extend edits to parameter ties, state fields, scan bodies and update equations. Revalidate full initializer/update/finalize/predict consistency.

**Done when:** actual GP changes a learning procedure, refits it and emits a valid artifact; no donated fitted state or broadened capability is accepted. Gates: G09/G08.

**WP14 — Successor policy training and decoding.**  
Owner competency: policy ML. Depends: WP05/WP13A; state actions require WP13B.

Implement the factorized policy, exact structural targets, conditional masks, numeric chart law and versioned checkpoint binding. Preserve the old release.

**Done when:** exact action replay and support-law checks pass; held-out policy-on/off discovery at matched total resources supports deployment. Gates: G10/G13.

**WP15 — Full learner recipe export.**  
Owner competency: compiler/numerical. Depends: WP11; extend with WP12 as derivative support qualifies.

Emit the training schedule, update/derivative runtime, finalization and prediction. Begin with Rust; then qualify Python/C++17 subsets. Keep fitted exports from earlier slices.

**Done when:** a fresh process fits new authorized data using the generated recipe, freezes/reloads/predicts, and agrees under the declared numerical contract without the original repository. Gate: G08.

**WP16 — Proximal and potential modules.**  
Owner competency: numerical researcher. Depends: WP10–WP12 as applicable.

Start with soft thresholding and simple projections. Add a small certified potential AST only after solve/AD interfaces pass.

**Done when:** W08/W17/W18 closed forms, gradients, constraints, residuals and exports pass. A research experiment may reject the module without invalidating the core release. Gates: G06/G07/G13.

**WP17 — Typed library learning.**  
Owner competency: synthesis/search. Depends: WP13A, then WP13B for learning bodies.

Implement exact hygienic functions, bounded expansion, typed anti-unification and source-family tracking. Compare fixed/no/learned libraries.

**Done when:** captured scope cannot leak; expansion preserves effects/cost; held-development-family utility is measured after library-construction costs. Gate: G12.

**WP18 — Runtime and cache optimization.**  
Owner competency: performance/runtime. Depends: relevant reference/exact-state slices.

Profile dispatch, repeated fitting, serialization and emission; add liveness/workspace reuse and qualified batching/compilation.

**Done when:** equivalence, seed/budget preservation and measured break-even evidence pass; baseline protected resources remain available. Gates: G01/G11.

**WP19 — Prospective evaluation and confirmation.**  
Owner competency: evaluation/statistics. Depends: a frozen candidate release with all required semantic/export gates.

Register family splits, comparator budgets, power, failure handling, primary endpoint and multiplicity. Execute development selection and one justified confirmation.

**Done when:** a complete result—including negative/inconclusive outcomes—is reproducible; no failure or expenditure is omitted. Gate: G13.

**WP20 — Release/promotion/rollback.**  
Owner competency: maintainer/runtime. Depends: all applicable gates; default promotion additionally requires WP19.

Publish immutable compatible bundles and change only future-run pointers. Keep a known-good bundle, profile defaults and artifact readers.

**Done when:** stale/mismatched gate evidence cannot activate a release; rollback stops new admissions to the successor and restores future defaults without rewriting active-run semantics. Gate: G14.

**WP21 — Specialized research packs.**  
Owner competency: relevant domain researcher. Depends: core semantics plus task/data contracts.

Add probability, semirings, geometry, dynamics, operators or transport one module at a time. No pack receives global generation weight merely because it compiles.

**Done when:** its task-specific witnesses, costs, export subset and value experiment pass; otherwise retain it as experimental.
